title: Re-Rating Corrections: Autopay Goodwill Bands for Rental Contracts
content:
A Rental Property Service Contracts re-rating correction carries an autopay goodwill rate read from the contract's payment history.

| Most recent premium payment posted on the contract | Returned payment billed back on the contract in the 12 months before the correction | Autopay goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| made by ACH | none | 0.03 |
| made by ACH | one or more | 0.01 |
| made another way | any | 0 |

**Records read.** The payment method of the latest premium payment in the contract's billing history; the returned payment charges and their dates.

**How the rate acts.** Every goodwill rate on a re-rating correction is added to one in a single sum, and the correction is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* last payment by ACH, a returned payment five months earlier: 0.01.
